summary: The StudentEmployment user control in HSPnet displays and manages student employment placements, showing placement details and enabling access to placement request information in a web application. It binds a data grid of employment records to the current user session and student context, with customizable UI elements, conditional visibility, and integration with session and placement entities.
purpose: To display student employment placement data for a student, enabling users (primarily Placement Coordinators) to view, access, and interact with employment records and placement requests, with appropriate permissions and session context.

workflows.name: Display Student Employment Placements
steps: DataBind is called, linking the user session and student context.
ObjectDataSource dsGridData retrieves student employment records using session and StudentID.
Repeater rprStudEmployment binds employment records to UI.
For each record, display supervisor caption and placement data.
Conditional UI logic sets row visibility and class based on record type and parent placement status.
Details button generates placement request detail link if the record is accessible.
Footer row is only visible if AlternateObservation flag is set.

business_rules: UserSession must be set for data selection; otherwise, selection is canceled.
Rows are conditionally visible based on ParentPRDID, PR_ID, and AgencyID matching session.
Details button only enabled if placement request ID is valid and placement agency matches user session.
Supervisor caption is trimmed and displayed for header.
Footer is shown only when AlternateObservation is true.
validations: Verify UserSession presence before selecting data.
Enable Details button only when PR_ID is not zero and agency is correct.
conditions: Details button visible/enabled if PR_ID != 0 and PlcAgencyID == UserSession.AgencyID.
Footer row visible if AlternateObservation is true.
Row classes determined by item type (alternating/regular).
system_behavior: Auto-generates UI controls for student employment records.
Binds data based on user session and student ID.
Customizes UI elements dynamically based on data item and session context.
Generates hashed URL for placement request details via JavaScript.
dependencies: PRSearchStudent entity for employment record data.
Hashing and QueryString utilities for secure URL generation.
exceptions: Data selection canceled if UserSession is null.
UI elements may be hidden or disabled if business rule conditions are not met.
content_gaps: Underlying data access and logic for PRSearchStudent and ObjectDataSource not included.
No details on full field mapping or data schema.
No information on error handling outside session validation.
